From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah McCarthy <hannah.m@cloudco.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR readiness: roadmap consolidation & contingency asks

Team — attaching a tight consolidation of PM/Eng status for the QBR pack (attached: QBR-roadmap-consolidation-v2.xlsx). High level:

1) Ship-by-ship: three launches targeted in Jan/Feb (Embedding caching infra patch, Hosted API perf improvements, Dedicated autoscale beta). Two are green/amber; Dedicated autoscale is at amber due to infra churn.
2) Contingency asks: we need a small runway for a canary rollback (1-2 reserved GPU nodes) and a short credits bucket to stabilize customer-facing demos.
3) Exec asks for the QBR: a one-slide risk summary + proposed mitigations by EOD Tuesday.

Specific asks:
- Karthik: detail the remaining infra blocker on autoscale and an impact table (latency, throughput, customer-facing impact) by EOD Tuesday.
- Monica: consolidate owner names and escalation leads on the sheet; highlight any resource gaps.
- Laura: confirm if we can assign the two senior SRE shifts for the canary window (Jan 10-14).

I copied Hannah to flag any external ask from CloudCo for the Hosted API perf milestone — she might want alignment for their pilot.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: roadmap consolidation & contingency asks

Thanks Aditya — quick status and I"'ll fill the table in the attached sheet.

- Autoscale beta: blocker is an intermittent orchestration race when scaling from 0->N under high request burst. Repro rate ~1/50 with current load generator test. Root cause points to a race in our instance registration path; suspected metadata syncing latency with control-plane index.
- Impact: when it hits, customers see 300-500ms latency spike and occasional 502s for ~10s; recoverable but bad for demos.
- Mitigation plan: short term (next 72h) add a guarded retry + backoff on the registration path; medium term (2 weeks) land a fix in the orchestration library and stress test.

Can do the 1-slide risk + proposed mitigations by EOD Tue. I recommend the reserved 1-2 GPU nodes for canary to reduce churn during the rollout.

Karthik
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Infra
[Attachment: Launch-contingency-matrix.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks team — good concise updates. A couple of executive-level clarifications before I finalize the QBR slide: 

1) Severity framing: use a 3-point scale (low/med/high) tied to clear customer outcomes (demo interruption, pilot SLA breach, revenue at risk). For Dedicated autoscale put worst-case as HIGH if the repro rate isn't reduced to <1/1000 before the pilot.
2) Contingency funding: approve a small credits bucket and the 2 reserved GPU nodes for the canary window. Finance will get a follow-up note from me; treat as green to proceed on ops procurement.
3) Rollback playbook: Karthik to own. Laura to validate SRE runbook. Aditya/Monica to ensure the exec slide has the one-line ask and the acceptance criteria for mitigation.

Hannah — FYI, we"'ve approved the reserved canary capacity and will include a short mitigation note in the QBR. If CloudCo has a specific cutover window preference, flag it by Friday and we"'ll accommodate.

I"'ll take the consolidated slide and finalize wording for the QBR deck; please push your updated artifacts to the shared Drive link by EOD Thursday.

Vivek
VP Product
Redwood Inference
